LanguageData.FB_HemoghoulChildhood.title: flesh-bound
LanguageData.FB_HemoghoulChildhood.description: Whatever [PAWN_nameDef] once was is gone. The fingerspike rewrote the body for tireless labor and left nothing of the old life behind.
LanguageData.FB_HemoghoulAdulthood.title: hemoghoul
LanguageData.FB_HemoghoulAdulthood.description: [PAWN_nameDef] serves the flesh colony as a hemoghoul: a hemogel-fed body that works without rest and asks for nothing.
